# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Job Application Screen

**Purpose**: Test whether the spec, plan and UI-states contract fully and unambiguously define the
form's states, validation behaviour and accessibility requirements before implementation.
Reviewer-facing (PR / spec review), standard depth.
**Created**: 2026-10-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/ui-states.md](../contracts/ui-states.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are requirements defined for what the page shows on load when an application has already been sent from this browser? [Gap, Spec §US1-4, research §10]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the submitting state's visible label and progress indicator specified in the spec, not only in the UI-states contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements defined for how the submitting state is announced to screen-reader users? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the CV-rejected state's announcement to assistive technology specified (live region, or only the field description)? [Gap, Spec §US3-5, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the CV dragging state's visual treatment defined with reference to a design state or token? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are hover, focus and error visual states specified for every interactive element, including the drop area, "Remove" and the confirmation actions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is it specified that the CV control is labelled "CV" and that its hint and error are associated with the control? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is "visible focus indicator" defined with measurable properties (ring width, offset, colour, minimum contrast)? [Clarity, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is it clear which focus treatment applies to inputs versus buttons/links, given the style sheet defines two different ones? [Ambiguity, research §2]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "10MB" defined as 10,000,000 or 10,485,760 bytes in the spec itself? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, data-model]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the email rule in FR-008 worded precisely enough to decide cases like "a@b@c.com" and "a@.com"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "the first 500 characters" defined in a unit (code units vs. user-perceived characters) so emoji and accented input behave predictably? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the file-size display rule specified at boundaries (exactly 1 MB, 10 MB, rounding)? [Clarity, Spec §US3-3]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "truncated with an ellipsis if long" defined in terms of available width rather than a character count? [Clarity, Spec §US3-3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Do FR-005 ("no errors before the first send") and US3-5 / FR-011 (rejection errors at selection time) agree, or is an explicit exception stated? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is focus behaviour during submitting ("stays on button") consistent with the button becoming disabled, which can drop focus in some browsers? [Conflict, ui-states.md, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the CV error priority consistent: does a rejection message replace "Attach your CV to apply." after a failed send, and which one shows after Remove? [Consistency, Spec §US3-4, §US3-5, tasks T044]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are the breakpoints (≤420px, ≥900px) consistent across ui-states.md, plan and tasks, with the wireframe's 640px pairing explicitly superseded? [Consistency, ui-states.md]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does clearing the failure alert on the next send (tasks T026) appear in the spec's requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for dropping a file onto the attached-file row (replace or ignore)? [Gap, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for dragging non-file content (text, links) over the drop area? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §US3-2]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is behaviour defined when the candidate cancels the file picker with a CV already attached? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §US3-1]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is it specified whether validation re-runs when only the cover note changes after a failed send? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the failure path after a failed validation then a storage failure covered (which alert shows, where focus goes)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-006, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for leaving the page mid-application (unsaved data warning or not)? [Gap, Recovery]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the "Start again" focus target specified after the empty form returns? [Gap, Spec §FR-020]

## Accessibility (Non-Functional)

- [ ] CHK027 - Is AA contrast required for non-text elements (input borders, drop-area border, focus rings) at 3:1, not only for text? [Completeness, Constitution §II, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is visibility of focus and state in Windows high-contrast / forced-colours mode addressed? [Gap, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are heading-level requirements defined for the page (h1 role title, h2 sections, confirmation heading)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements for reduced motion stated, if any transition is used for state changes? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is a minimum touch-target size specified for "Remove" and other small controls at 360px? [Gap, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the error summary required to link to, or otherwise lead to, each failing field? [Gap, Spec §US2-2]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK033 - Can SC-001 ("under 5 minutes") be objectively measured, and is the measuring method stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is SC-006 ("every state meets WCAG AA contrast") tied to an explicit list of states to be checked? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, ui-states.md]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the plan's "interactive in < 2 s on a mid-range phone over 4G" backed by a defined device/network profile? [Measurability, plan Performance Goals]
